In this video we explore Delta table cloning, explaining what cloning is, why it’s useful, and the two types—shallow and deep clones. We walk through a hands‑on demo in Databricks to show how each clone works, the differences in metadata and data copying, performance, storage cost, independence from the source, and ideal use cases for development, testing, and backup scenarios.
What you will learn:
• The definition of shallow cloning vs. deep cloning in Delta tables
• How to create both types of clones using SQL syntax
